name: spanish-ugc-community-spokesperson-hook
description: Encodes a Spanish-language UGC ad pattern built around a warm, trusted community-insider spokesperson — a mid-50s professional woman who opens with a direct rhetorical question that forces the viewer to confront a personal fear (a costly future event, debt, family burden), then transitions through empathy, solution, and a phone-call CTA. Deploy this skill whenever the target audience is Spanish-speaking, the product is a high-trust service in a considered-purchase category, the platform is TikTo
author: Official
